metadata.description: Repo-scoped Codex marketplace for SumSec-Skills. Add with `codex plugin marketplace add SummerSec/SumSec-Skills --ref main`; each plugin entry points to a subdirectory in this checkout.

plugins.name: writing-zh
plugins.description: Chinese writing tools for de-AIifying text, Markdown-to-slides workflows, personal-voice long-form writing, and SumSec article illustrations.

plugins.name: media-tools
plugins.description: Media generation skills for AI image creation and Remotion React video best practices.

plugins.name: dev-tools
plugins.description: Developer utilities for git commit and PR workflows, local agent history lookup, current library docs, Ponytail minimal-solution skills, a bundled Ponytail MCP server, polished frontend implementation, and UI prototype generation.

plugins.name: agents-dev
plugins.description: Agent development skills for skill creation, skill optimization, workflow skill design, hook writing, and multi-platform plugin metadata maintenance.

plugins.name: claude-code-setup
plugins.description: Analyze codebases and recommend tailored Claude Code automations such as hooks, skills, MCP servers, and subagents.

plugins.name: claude-md-management
plugins.description: Tools to maintain and improve CLAUDE.md files, audit quality, capture session learnings, and keep project memory current.

plugins.name: hookify
plugins.description: Create hooks to prevent unwanted behaviors by analyzing conversation patterns, with regex matching and multiple event types.

plugins.name: plugin-dev
plugins.description: Plugin development toolkit with skills for agent, command, hook, skill, MCP, plugin structure, and plugin settings development.
